purpose: Teach: 異国/もとづい/予知/相反/強硬/残虐/妊婦/修道院

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、異国の生活様式を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on foreign ways of life, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle confirmation seeking, not interrogation. Teacher-to-student ease. Slight upward lift at the end, inviting him in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、史料にもとづいた歴史検証を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined historical sources to verify the theories.
lines.style: Careful, precise delivery. Slight hesitation before diving in. Respectful but not stiff. Speaks to the work itself, not to being questioned.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、地震予知の科学を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: So your paper looked at earthquake prediction science?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Genuine curiosity in the voice. Attentive, like she's genuinely interested in understanding his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、二つの理論が相反する点を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on where the two theories contradict each other.
lines.style: Steady, methodical tone. No flourish. Direct and clear. The confidence of someone who knows exactly what he studied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 外交の強硬路線を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And your paper addressed hardline diplomatic policy?
lines.style: Slight lean forward in attention. Engaged but measured. Respectful of the weight of the subject. No performance, just genuine listening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時の残虐行為を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined wartime atrocities and their historical record.
lines.style: Calm, serious delivery. Weight behind the words. Not rushing. Acknowledges the gravity of what he's describing without dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、妊婦の心理研究を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: I see you wrote on the psychology of pregnant women?
lines.style: Observant, checking her notes or memory. Warm but precise. A gentle question, asked with genuine interest in his answer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、中世修道院の生活を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually focused on daily life in medieval monasteries.
lines.style: Quiet correction, offered without defensiveness. Clear and direct. Slight closing cadence, like he's wrapping up this thread of conversation.
